propositions: Author a new Pass-1 overlay prompt document code-review-concurrency.md that applies a lockset-first quartet rubric to detect races caused by unlocked accessors of shared resources that bypass existing serialization discipline.

The rubric must enforce four mandatory elements in every finding: the shared mutable resource, two or more concurrent executors with spawn/entry points, the interleaving window with quoted operations, and concrete harm (not vague descriptions).

The prompt must include disposition-aware guard suppression that distinguishes serialized-by-construction races, not-actually-shared resources, unreachable concurrency, and benign-tolerant races, with explicit defer-by-name lines routing attacker-framed TOCTOU to security and load-only races to performance.

The prompt must parse with correct frontmatter keys (outputs, execution_mode, category, dimension, langfuse_prompt), instruct criteria=[concurrency], forbid model-emitted severity, and document that empty findings are expected.
The document is inert until registered by dependent story errable-tricksome-ape, which adds the concurrency member to OVERLAY_IDS, routing entries, and code-review.yaml dispatch lines.
